blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ اْلاَرْضَ قف فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِنْ فِئَةٍ يَّنْصُرُونَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللهِ ق وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنْتَصِرِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his house; he had no party to help him besides Allah; nor was he of those who could defend themselves.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَي مُوسَي أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ؕ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Then We revealed to Musa (by Wahi): “Strike the sea with your staff!” (When he did so,) at once it split apart; and each part (that had split) became like a great mountain.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ م بِالْبَصَرِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Our command (is fulfilled) in a single moment, like the blink of an eye, with no (delay).
To Him alone belong creation and command.
You have no god other than Him.
